name: Label elements
help_text: What this channel's label carries, top to bottom in position order. Barcode is the symbol plus the code printed under its own bars — every label needs exactly one, and it takes whatever height the other elements leave, up to its max bar height. Title is the product name, wrapped to its line count. Text is a fixed line, such as the item condition Amazon requires at the bottom of an FBA label. Stacked text sits beside the bars, one character per line, set larger than the body text, and ignores position — that is Takealot's "MP". An empty font size means the layout sizes the text from the label height.
